comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (95.45%) to Chionodracine G: 18%, V=L=H: 14%. Activity: active against K. pneumoniae KPC (MIC 10.0-21.0 uM), ESBL E. coli (MIC 5.2-10.3 uM), XDR A. baumannii (MIC 5.2-10.3 uM), MDR P. aeruginosa (MIC 10.3-20.6 uM), S. aureus MRSA (MIC 20.6-41.2 uM), S. epidermidis (MIC 5.2-10.3 uM), and E. faecalis anti-VRE (MIC 5.2-10.3 uM). In total, 70 clinical strains were tested and the results are expressed as a range. Structure: random coil in PBS buffer and helical in POPC (1-Palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine) LUVs ((Large Unilamellar Vesicles).
title: Design and characterization of chionodracine-derived antimicrobial peptides with enhanced activity against drug-resistant human pathogens.
